layers.name: Runtime Actors

layers.description: Replicated and local actor state for control, stats, combat, perception, animation registries, movesets, and collision volumes consumed by higher-level systems.

layers.description: World-scoped orchestration for movement, stamina, AI, perception, combat phases, hit detection, camera behavior, and animation requests, including the explicit gameplay scheduler.

layers.description: Shared enums, payload structures, combat and animation data types, and the typed world event bus that decouple producers from gameplay-system consumers.

layers.description: Local-player HUD controllers and modular UMG widget components that translate replicated gameplay state into client-side interface output.

layers.description: Unreal module entry points, target and build rules, project descriptor, engine/game/input configuration, asset settings, and other platform-facing integration.
